narration: Can AI build a playable three D game? I gave Codex a robot obstacle course: moving platforms, glowing coins, and a finish portal. This is the local prototype it wrote. I tested the controls, collected the coins, then reached the portal. It runs, but this took code fixes, and it is not a finished game. Treat AI output as a starting point you still need to test. Subscribe for more AI experiments.
